title: Locks.
officialText:
Egress doors are permitted to be locked in accordance with the applicable use condition. Doors from a refuge area to the
exterior are permitted to be locked with a key in lieu of locking methods described in Section 408.4.1. The keys to unlock th e exterior doors
shall be available at all times and the locks shall be operable from both sides of the door.
